description: List pending contentrain (cr/*) branches with their merge status against the contentrain branch. Use this to discover branch names for contentrain_merge / contentrain_branch_delete, and to monitor branch-health limits (warning at 50, blocked at 80 unmerged).

remote.description: Also check the git remote: annotate entries with on_remote and report remote-only cr/* leftovers. Requires network. Default: false

unmerged_only.description: Only list branches not yet merged into contentrain. Default: false

name: contentrain_branch_list
